summary_en: GMO Financial Gate raised FY2026 year-end dividend forecast by 4 yen to 131 yen per share, reflecting better-than-expected earnings performance. Annual dividend for FY2026 is now projected at 131 yen, up from 127 yen announced in September 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Hike)
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, GMO Financial Gate's board of directors approved a revision to the FY2026 dividend forecast. The company raised the year-end dividend by 4 yen per share to 131 yen, compared to the previous forecast of 127 yen per share announced on September 10, 2026. This results in a total annual dividend for FY2026 of 131 yen per share.

The company attributed the increase to better-than-expected earnings performance during the period. According to the disclosure, the company recognizes shareholder returns as an important management priority and implements a policy of stable and continuous dividends by comprehensively considering internal reserves required for business expansion and funding needs, balanced against profitability.

The final dividend amount is subject to confirmation by the board of directors scheduled for November 16, 2026. For reference, the company paid 99 yen per share in dividends for FY2025 (ended September 2025).
